TARGET.canonical: Sum of effectiveTarget(cycle) for cycles in the reporting month that are not cancelled_eviction / cancelled_daily / pending_payment_daily. effectiveTarget = baseAmountFils - active discounts.
TARGET.not: UI occupancy status strings, paid_amount, or collected labels.

ACTUAL_COLLECTED.canonical: Sum of active approved collectionEvents (schema v3) net of reversals/refunds, plus classified opening residuals. Cash is collected on receipt; bank is collected on owner approveBankPayment.
ACTUAL_COLLECTED.not: status=collected, occupancy edits, or deposit requests.

DEPOSITED.canonical: Approved bank collectionEvents (method=bank) + active cashMovements type=deposit minus deposit_reversal, plus classified opening deposited residuals.
DEPOSITED.not: Merely marking a unit collected. Employee deposit request has zero deposited effect until approveDeposit.

EMPLOYEE_HOLDING.canonical: Sum of cashLotAvailable(lot) by currentHolder. Cash receipts create lots; deposits/refunds/transfers consume them. Bank never creates a lot.
EMPLOYEE_HOLDING.not: Math.max(0, collected-deposited). Negative available throws CASH_LOT_INVARIANT.

ARREARS.canonical: Remaining collectible on active cycles whose dueDate <= asOfDate.

REMAINING.canonical: targetFils - tenantReceivedReservedFils. CYCLE_OVERPAYMENT if reserved exceeds target.

definitions.CASH_COLLECTION: createCashReceipt → paymentIntent method=cash + collectionEvent + cashLot held by actor.
definitions.BANK_COLLECTION: createBankPayment (pending, no collected/holding) → approveBankPayment (manager) credits revenue and deposited.
definitions.HANDOVER: createCustodyTransfer + confirmCustodyTransfer moves lot holder once. Zero collected/deposited/revenue effect.
definitions.EXPENSE: requestExpense pending → approveExpense manager debit of chosen account exactly once. reverseExpense is a compensating event.
definitions.DAILY: Employee submits add_daily. Owner createDailyBooking (manager-only) then approveBusinessRequest. Cash daily uses createCashReceipt internally.

writePath: financialCommand | operationalCommand (server) → authorization → idempotency (financialOperations/operationalOperations) → canonical mutation → ledger/balances/custody → operationalReadModel projection → UI CALC cards
